It folds provider-reported token usage out of session logs and"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" charts it in Settings."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Host DSH peers and development dependencies use the open lower-bound range `>=0.1.7-alpha.2`. The lo"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ckfile resolves DSH `0.1.7-rc.2` packages and Cordis `4.0.4`. Optional peers let the plugin remain l"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"oadable outside the supported set."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"`package.json#dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` records DSH `0.1.7-alpha.2`, `0.1.7-rc.1`, and `0.1.7-r"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"c.2` as compatible evidence, not an allowlist. Unknown newer Hosts warn once and keep the normal mou"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"nt path. Only a reproduced failure is blocklisted."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## What it shows"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- Tokens, requests, output tokens, and cache-hit rate
- Stacked chart with Metric (token / request),"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" By (provider / model / workspace), Group (day / week)

- A responsi"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ve overview with a full-width token summary, compact secondary metrics, a stacked chart, and token-s"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"hare cards that follow the current By grouping
- On narrow screens, the cards collapse to one column"},{"id":"p9s5","text":" and the chart legend scrolls horizontally"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Escape closes an open Metric, By, or Group menu and restores focus to its trigger. With no menu open"},{"id":"p10s2","text":", Escape remains available to the Settings dialog."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Subscription quotas are not fetched."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Host development dependencies resolve to the rc.2 package set; see Compatibility. A source checkout can use a link installation after running `pnpm run build`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Then open **Settings → Usage**."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Data"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Reads live and persisted logs through the public `ctx.sessionQuery.readSession` API; `sessionPersist"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ence.list` supplies cache revisions only. The usage RPC uses the authenticated `/api/plugin-rpc/usag"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"e-monitor` Fetch route. It does not inspect private persistence methods or session file paths. Unrea"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"dable sessions are omitted; only folded usage aggregates are returned."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Release"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`pnpm run check` runs the full gate in order: unit tests, TypeScript typecheck, deterministic build-"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"parity (clean temp build vs tracked `lib/`), package build, and a real `npm pack` + immutable `fixtu"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"res/rc1-0.1.7` validation + offline install + Host/client import smoke. The pack check reads only th"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"e repository-owned 0.1.7-rc.1 manifest/tarballs, verifies the official tag/commit and registry integ"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"rity, preserves versioned parent edges, and uses a fresh pnpm consumer with an invalid registry, off"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"line/no-scripts/no-audit/no-fund settings, empty `NODE_PATH`, and scoped local-tarball overrides; it"},{"id":"p20s7","text":" uses neither `--legacy-peer-deps` nor omit/force bypasses. The owner archive is written only below "},{"id":"p20s8","text":"the prefixed temporary directory. It does not rewrite `lib/` before comparison, so a stale, missing "},{"id":"p20s9","text":"or hand-edited artifact fails."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"For a tag, run `pnpm run check:strict` (the same test, typecheck, parity, build, and pack order with"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" `PARITY_CHECK_HEAD=1`; it fails if the committed `lib/` still differs from the source — the v0.2.5 "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"drift guard). Keep `src` as the source of truth and commit the rebuilt `lib/`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The Settings → Usage nav icon is a DOM patch via `ctx.effect` + `MutationObserver` on `document.body"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"`; see `src/client/nav-icon.ts` for the `ctx.effect` disposer and the accepted Alpha.4 DOM risk."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Release installation (Latest)"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Session-log usage dashboard with responsive metric cards, charting, and provider shares.
